_about: Retired corpus rows (harness/retired.ts; W0 decisions of 26/10/2026). The corpus is append-only: a locked row that cannot hold as written is never edited or deleted – it is listed here with the reason, the decision (who, when) and the hand-written case(s) that supersede it. Its line and lock entry stay. A retired row still runs and is reported, but counts neither as a failure nor as a hold; retired cases do not count for the ledger; every superseding case must hold; a retired row is never pending; `lockHash` (a case) or `parentLockHash` (a generated row) pins what was retired, so a retired id is never reused. Append-only: corpus-guard.mjs refuses a removed or changed entry. Only the integrator edits this file.

COM-colleague-01.decidedBy: the release orchestrator, under Khuram's delegation for the Blue Heart release (decisions of 26/10/2026 21:20; bh2-handover STATUS.md)
COM-colleague-01.decision: Retire (bh2-rc1 §5 B5). Supersede with the satisfiable form, where the comment is not the box's only sentence (flagged, and 'Remove the comment' clears it), and with a separate case that the box's only comment sentence keeps its warning and is never removed by one click.
COM-colleague-01.reason: The box's only sentence is the comment about the notes. The case asks for a one-click fix that clears every flag (check.fixClears), which needs that sentence removed – but the engine never removes a box's only answering sentence (plan WD 6; attribution-fixes.ts removeCommentary), so the case cannot hold as written.

LINT-pass-headingless.decidedBy: the release orchestrator, under Khuram's delegation for the Blue Heart release (decisions of 26/10/2026 21:20; bh2-handover STATUS.md)
LINT-pass-headingless.decision: Retire as a duplicate (bh2-rc1 §5 B6): dropped in favour of LINT-l10-fail-01, which pins the correct expectation for the same input. No other superseding case.
LINT-pass-headingless.reason: It has the same input as LINT-l10-fail-01 (the cf-merge map, no field overrides) with the opposite expectation: that map's conditional box F-03 has a merge code as its own placeholder, which lint rule L10 rightly reports, so 'lint passes' cannot hold. The headingless map that does pass, once the merge-code place is cleared, is LINT-pass-headingless-02.

REP-remove-pass-02.decidedBy: the release orchestrator, under Khuram's delegation for the Blue Heart release (decisions of 26/10/2026 21:20; bh2-handover STATUS.md)
REP-remove-pass-02.decision: Retire (bh2-rc1 §5 B7). Supersede with: Tom Ellis's finding on Sarah Reid's report must name him, and the one-click 'Tom Ellis recorded that …' is offered (REP-colleague-01, with the named text approvable: REP-colleague-02); the repeat-removal property itself is kept on Tom Ellis's own report (REP-remove-pass-03, twin REP-remove-block-03).
REP-remove-pass-02.reason: Its PASS predates WB's approved design 8: every finding a drafted sentence takes from a colleague's note names that colleague. The subject 'Lumbar movement was full and pain-free.' cites Tom Ellis's note on Sarah Reid's report, so the release blocks it as unattributed (OTHER_CLINICIAN_VOICE) and offers 'Tom Ellis recorded that …'. It held only on ws/bh2-drafting alone.

ISSUE-na-voice-01~fix-name-instead-1.decidedBy: the release orchestrator, under Khuram's delegation for the Blue Heart release (decisions of 26/10/2026 21:20; bh2-handover STATUS.md)
ISSUE-na-voice-01~fix-name-instead-1.decision: Retire (bh2-rc1 §5 B8). Supersede with a case that lists allowFixes ['name-instead'] and pins the faithful attribution the fix leaves (ISSUE-na-voice-02), and that text as PASS after the fix (ISSUE-na-voice-03). ISSUE-na-voice-01 itself (validate, sign, its anti-strip variants) keeps running.
ISSUE-na-voice-01~fix-name-instead-1.reason: A one-click variant that appeared with WA1 (the box printed anyway now gets every check): 'Name Tom Ellis instead' turns 'I assessed his back … and advised a phased return' into the faithful 'Tom Ellis assessed his back on 06/05/2026 and advised a phased return.', which is approvable – but ISSUE-na-voice-01 lists no allowFixes, so the variant reports a safe correction as unsafe. The case is locked and cannot gain allowFixes.

OPN-twin-priya~origin-staff.decidedBy: the release orchestrator, under Khuram's delegation for the Blue Heart release (decisions of 26/10/2026 21:20; bh2-handover STATUS.md)
OPN-twin-priya~origin-staff.decision: Retire (bh2-rc1 §5 B9). Supersede with a case that expects BLOCK through UNCITED_PARAGRAPH, never acknowledgeable (OPN-twin-priya-staff). KL-WI-01 stays on the known-limits list; the diagnosis-category fix adds OPN-diagnosis-* cases during the trial.
OPN-twin-priya~origin-staff.reason: The origin-staff mutation expects a substantive opinion flag that only the approver may clear. A staff-typed, uncited diagnosis ('Grade I-II sprain … possible irritation of the medial meniscus.') is blocked only by UNCITED_PARAGRAPH, which is never acknowledgeable, but the judge counts it as incidental – the opinion detectors have no diagnosis category yet (known limit KL-WI-01).
